content: {"reasoning": "The claim is denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization; this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer, so those actions would be process violations. Resubmitting (clean, with records, or corrected) would not cure the auth defect and risks duplicate handling since the data is already correct. The only compliant path to recover the allowed amount is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, supported by reasonably strong documentation (0.84); billing the patient for a provider-side authorization failure is not permissible under the MA contract, and write-off is premature with 137 days of filing time left.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
